name: For Ever Melancholia
source: An archaeology student is sent to do his summer training in a place far away from civilization. There he meets three beautiful girls who share his passion for cinema and art. What can possibly go wrong?
translation: 一名考古专业的学生被派往远离文明的地方进行暑期训练。在那里，他遇到了三个美丽的女孩，她们和他一样对电影和艺术充满热情。可能会出现什么问题？
